Description

2020 Bowman is a 100-card set, supplemented by a 150-card Prospects set, that was released May 27th. Each Hobby box yields one autograph, 19 inserts, and one Atomic Refractor. Hobby Jumbo boxes will contain three autographs.

Due to the COVID-19 outbreak, 2020 Bowman -- along with other Topps releases -- was delayed from its original release date of April 10th as the Texas-based facility that produces and distributes Topps' pack-based products was ordered closed by the Texas state government.

1st Edition

On April 17th, one week after 2020 Bowman's original release date, Topps announced 2020 Bowman 1st Edition. 1st Edition featured the 150 Prospects only, with each card, all printed on paper cardstock, stamped with a "1st Edition" logo -- similar to Bowman releases in 2004 and 2005. Ten-card packs, which retailed for $14.99 each, were available on Topps' website for three days beginning April 22nd. A limited number of 24-pack 1st Edition Hobby boxes were also distributed to Hobby dealers and group breakers.

1st Edition was produced and distributed in the same Florida facility that handles Topps' other online-exclusive cards (e.g. Topps Now, Topps On-Demand, Throwback Thursday, et al) which remained open during the COVID-19 crisis.

Chrome Autographs

Chrome Autographs were randomly seeded into 1st Edition packs, with each card also stamped with a "1st Edition" logo. These are the only Chrome cards in the product. It appears that many of the Chrome Autographs inserted into 1st Edition packs were smeared and may have been intended for the 2020 Bowman Baseball release, but were pulled for quality control purposes.

Various serial-numbered Refractor parallels appear to be available; however, since Topps did not issue a Chrome Autographs checklist, nor did they announce which specific Refractors were inserted into 1st Edition packs, it is unclear as to the production figures on these cards. Many of the 1st Edition Chrome Autographs appear to be from the Atomic Refractor (serial-numbered to 100 copies) and Green Refractor (numbered to 99) parallels.

Distribution

Hobby: 24 packs per box, ten cards per pack. 12 boxes per case.

Retail: 24 packs per box, 12 cards per pack. 12 boxes per case.

Jumbo: 12 packs per box, 32 cards per pack. Eight boxes per case.

Rack: Two 12-card retail packs plus one five card Camo Prospects per pack.

Checklist

Base Set

NOTE: Luis Robert appears in both the base set (card #18) and the Prospects set (#BP-150). As with his card in Opening Day, Robert had yet to make his Major League debut before appearing in the base set.

To be fair to Topps, Robert was signed to a Major League contract and was expected to make the White Sox opening day roster; meaning that he should have made his Major League debut by the time of 2020 Bowman's original late-April release date (unlike his Opening Day card which was released before the actual opening day). Still, this card violates the MLBPA's long-standing rules on player selection (which date back to 2006) being limited to those who had actually appeared in a Major League game.
